dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Strongly falcate trailing edge characterized by a deep concave spline that terminates in a sharp posterior basal inflection point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded morphological apex with a medium-scale pixel radius.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep linear ascent at approximately 50 degrees relative to the longitudinal body axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent V-shaped notch/indentation located on the lower third of the trailing edge; several small, light-toned punctate lesions or pockmarks visible on the lateral flank and mid-fin surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Irregular dark pigmentation patch visible near the posterior base, adjacent to the trailing edge notch.
